mapper.sql: id, task_id, user_id, status, conversation_content, content_fingerprint, source_type, source_conversation_id, model_id, analysis_id, error_message, created_at, started_at, finished_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_analysis_task (task_id, user_id, status, conversation_content, content_fingerprint, source_type, source_conversation_id, model_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{conversationContent}, #{contentFingerprint}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceConversationId}, #{modelId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM conversation_analysis_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND content_fingerprint = #{contentFingerprint} AND (source_conversation_id IS NULL OR source_conversation_id = '') AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'SUCCEEDED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
